hypotheses.justification: This follows from rigidity and abelianness. TensorExact.lean supplies limit-preservation instances for tensorLeft and tensorRight. They therefore preserve terminal objects and zero morphisms; Functor.additive_of_preserves_binary_products makes both functors additive. Their map_zero and map_add properties supply all four fields of MonoidalPreadditive. Install this derived instance and retain the displayed proof. This also works for zero objects and trivial categories.

Factor p₁ = e ≫ m through its image, with e epi and m mono. Rigidity makes tensorRight W₂ preserve monomorphisms, so p₁ ⊗ₘ p₂ = (e ⊗ₘ p₂) ≫ (m ▷ W₂) has the same kernel subobject as e ⊗ₘ p₂, by kernelSubobject_comp_mono. Apply the displayed epi-case argument to e and p₂. The kernel arrow of e factors through the kernel arrow of p₁; right whiskering this factorization gives the required comparison of their image subobjects. The other summand is unchanged. Image factorization and these comparisons remain valid for zero morphisms and zero objects.
